$description: Messaging scope tokens (added by ds init when messaging is enabled). Own/other bubble fg is pair-checked on its bubble bg in every theme. Presence colors are always paired with text (Online, Away, Busy, Offline) and meet 3:1 against color.bg.surface (WCAG 1.4.11, 1.4.1). Sender is conveyed by text, never by bubble color or alignment alone.

bg.$description: Own message bubble background; 6.7:1 with own.fg.

fg.$description: Text and links on own bubbles; 6.7:1.

online.$description: Online presence dot; 5.01:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff). Always with the text Online.

away.$description: Away presence dot; 5.02:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff). Always with the text Away.

busy.$description: Busy presence dot; 5.91:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff). Always with the text Busy.

offline.$description: Offline presence dot; 4.83:1 against color.bg.surface (#ffffff). Always with the text Offline.

max-width.$description: Maximum bubble width; long messages wrap, never fixed height (WCAG 1.4.12).
